block.text:
<thinking>Could deliver 16 pages though last page single callout and data page sparse. Is this acceptable? User asked doc not visual perfection; already long. I could improve last page by removing next update callout or merge before page break? It overflowed due keep table? It's single callout at page16. Could move next update callout to cover or remove from end (cover already current progress). It duplicates. Remove last callout from end entirely; cover states same. That eliminates page16. Data relation page14 sparse but meaningful, could add small explanatory table to use more page and consolidate. Not necessary but page14 only 5 lines with no "PPT04" header, seems unprofessional. Could instead not page break before relation label and let heading+first line page13 as previous, bad. Better move data relation to "02" section page15 as callout after action list? Or move data relation earlier, before "建议修正的两处原文" so page13 has data relation then original fixes spills to page14 with title and table; that gives page14 a proper heading and table, better. On page13 after issue7 at y1000, data relationship (label+4 lines) about250 fits up to1250, then "建议修正的两处原文" + table may fit to1550? Actually data ~300, issue7 end1000, label at1080, lines through1250, original title at1320, table height240 ends1560 fits perhaps. Could all fit page13, eliminating page14. Original before: issue7 end1005; original label at1080, table ends1365; data label at1440, first line at1500, rest overflow. If data before original, data label at1080 + lines to1280, original label at1360+ table240 ends1650 overflow => original table moves or splits to page14. So page14 would have original title+table maybe only, still similar. Could use compact table for data relationship (3 rows) and original table smaller. More work not necessary.

Alternative make data relation page14 into a "PPT04 小结：三类对象必须解耦" heading with explanatory diagram-like table and "本页评审结论" to fill moderate. This is adding content consistent with previous. Add add_para before relation label? Instead relation_label text "PPT 04｜建议的数据关系（本页小结）" font size16, before30 maybe. Add table three rows columns object, role, independent control. And note. This makes page14 meaningful. It would replace plain paragraphs with table. Since user asked 图文结合, this table helps. Add 3 columns [关系, 保存内容, 控制原则] with rows account, meter, circuit. Page14 title+table+note ~450, still sparse but better. Should preserve content exactly enough. Good.

Last page remove callout. It reduces to15. This is improvement. Should not overdo. Do it. Also perhaps prevent_row_split callout to avoid future? Add prevent_row_split(t) to add_callout; it currently one row may split; here last callout moved as whole anyway. Could set.

I'll self-check "章节首页留白用于区分PPT页次" but page14 is not section first; okay no problem.

Implement data table. Use label then add_table with rows. Instead existing 4 paras replace. Perhaps add callout at end? Table has teal header. Fine. Add_para explanation. Then remove final next update callout. Already cover says. To preserve next update note in self-check maybe add sentence in 版式检查? Not necessary, user wants continuation not text. I can put in "02" intro "后续仅从实际讨论页追加。" but not needed.

I'll edit.</thinking>

{"file_path":"/Users/etherealshio/Documents/deepseek-harness/feishu/design-output/20261109-园区预付费结算PPT逐页评审/scripts/create_review_doc.py","old_string":"relation_label = add_label(doc, '建议的数据关系')
relation_label.paragraph_format.page_break_before = True
add_para(doc, '企业主体 → 结算账户（首期可一企一账户）', bold=True, color=NAVY, size=11, after=3)
add_para(doc, '企业主体 → 计量点／表计（记录拓扑、倍率、费率与有效期）', bold=True, color=NAVY, size=11, after=3, keep=True)
add_para(doc, '企业主体 → 费控对象／可控回路（独立授权、独立状态）', bold=True, color=NAVY, size=11, after=6, keep=True)
add_para(doc, '三类关系通过企业关联，但分别配置、分别授权、分别留痕；不要让电表直接等同于余额账户或拉闸对象。', color=TEAL, size=10, keep=True)","new_string":"relation_label = add_para(doc, 'PPT 04 小结｜建议的数据关系', bold=True, color=NAVY, size=18, after=5, keep=True)
relation_label.paragraph_format.page_break_before = True
add_para(doc, '一企多表不是把账户、电表和开关合成一个对象，而是以企业为主体关联三类独立数据。', color=MID_GRAY, size=10, after=10)
add_table(doc, ['企业关联对象', '需要保存的业务内容', '必须独立的控制'], [
    ('结算账户（首期可一企一账户）', '款项入账、计费扣账、账单核销、余额与待结清记录。', '账户汇总费用，不直接等同于任何一块表或一个开关。'),
    ('计量点／表计', '总分表拓扑、计量角色、起止读数、时点、倍率、费率与有效期。', '按表和时段计量计费，支持修订追溯与防重。'),
    ('费控对象／可控回路', '回路归属、可控／只读／禁控属性、授权、指令与实际状态。', '独立授权和状态核验，不因统一账户而自动统一拉闸。'),
], [4.2, 6.5, 5.9], font_size=9.3)
add_callout(doc, '关联原则', '三类关系通过企业关联，但分别配置、分别授权、分别留痕；企业账单必须能够追溯到每块表、每个时段和每条计费明细。')"}
